column4: ಅಗ್ನಿರ್ವಾವ ಸಂವತ್ಸರಃ । ಆದಿತ್ಯಃ ಪರಿವತ್ಸರಃ । ಚಂದ್ರಮಾ ಇದಾವತ್ಸರಃ । ವಾಯುರನು ವತ್ಸರಃ ।
column5: The Sanskrit quotation from the Taittirīya Brāhmaṇa is cut short: the Kannada's last two clauses (candramā idāvatsaraḥ | vāyuranu vatsaraḥ) are not given.
The gloss "(fate)" has no counterpart in the Kannada.
The glosses "(own nature)" and "(law)" are not in the Kannada.
